content: अद्भुत {%a.%} [<ls>Uṇ. 5. 1</ls> अदि भुवो डुतच्; according to <ls>Nir.</ls> न भूतम् the like of which did not take place before.] .²1 Wonderful, marvellous; ˚कर्मन् of wonderful deeds; ˚गन्ध having wonderful smell; ˚दर्शन, ˚रूप; prodigious; extraordinary, transcendental, supernatural. .²2 <ab>Ved.</ab> Unobserved, invisible (<ab>opp.</ab> दृश्य). .{@-तम्@} .²1 A wonder, a wonderful thing or occurrence, a prodigy, miracle; देव अद्भुतं खलु संवृत्तम् <ls>Ś. 5</ls> a wonderful or unexpected occurrence; आकालिकमनध्यायं विद्यात्सर्वाद्भुतेषु च <ls>Ms. 4. 118</ls>. .²2 Surprise, astonishment, wonder ({%m.%}) also; ˚उद्भ्रान्तदेवासुराणि विकान्तचरितानि <ls>U. 6</ls> lost in wonder. .²3 One of the five proportions of the measurement of height; in this measurement height is twice the breadth; हीनं तु द्वयं तद्द्विगुणं चाद्भुतं कथितम् <ls>Māna. 11. 20. 23</ls>. .{@-तः@} .²1 One of the 8 or 9 {%Rasas%}, the marvellous sentiment; जगति जनितात्यद्भुतरसः <ls>U. 3. 44</ls>. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of the Indra of the 9th Manvantara.
